subject.title: Feature request: Local plugin scanner CLI for pre-publish validation

question: Should ClawHub expose this as an expanded `clawhub package validate` flow, a hosted-parity local scan command, or keep full ClawScan dry runs internal-only for now?
rationale: The code shape is clear, but the permanent public contract affects security scanner semantics, author-visible evidence, secret redaction, and CLI/API placement.

options.title: Expand package validate
options.body: Add safe deterministic scanner and metadata checks to the existing plugin validation command, with explicit documentation for what hosted ClawScan signals it does not mirror.

options.title: Add hosted-parity scan command
options.body: Build a submit-and-poll local plugin scan path with ephemeral uploads and report downloads, accepting the larger backend/security surface.

options.title: Keep full scans internal
options.body: Keep public authors on Plugin Inspector validation plus publish-time scan results while retaining local ClawScan helpers for trusted maintainers only.

recommendation.title: Expand package validate
recommendation.body: Add safe deterministic scanner and metadata checks to the existing plugin validation command, with explicit documentation for what hosted ClawScan signals it does not mirror.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick-Erichsen owns the most recent public CLI/package validation surface and the repo-local ClawScan helper history.
